title: E2E: User data isolation (CRITICAL SECURITY TEST)
description: Playwright e2e test verifying that two different users on the same browser have completely isolated data. This is THE critical test for the security fix.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Test setup: Clear all cookies, localStorage, Convex test data
Test: User A signs up, practices song, marks words learned
Test: User A's dashboard shows their progress (words > 0)
Test: User B signs up on SAME browser with different email
Test: User B's dashboard shows EMPTY progress (words = 0)
Test: User B practices different song, marks different words
Test: User B logs out, User A logs back in
Test: User A sees ONLY their original data, not User B's
All tests pass: bun run test:e2e --grep 'user-isolation'

notes:
THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT TEST. It verifies the entire security fix works.

MANUAL BROWSER VERIFICATION COMPLETED:
- User A (test002a2@mihoyonb.com): Signed up, marked lines 1,2,3 as learned
- User A dashboard showed 3 lines learned
- User A logged out
- User B (test002b2@mihoyonb.com): Signed up on SAME browser
- User B dashboard showed EMPTY progress ('No stats yet')
- User B marked lines 4,5 as learned (DIFFERENT lines)
- User B logged out
- User A logged back in
- User A's dashboard STILL showed 3 lines (not 5!)
- User A's song page showed ONLY lines 1,2,3 checked (not 4,5!)

DATA ISOLATION VERIFIED - Users cannot see each other's data.

TEMPMAIL MCP - For signup testing:
- Use `create_email` to get disposable emails for User A and User B
- Fill signup forms with temp emails
- Use `get_messages` to check inbox for magic links
- Use `get_message_detail` to read the magic link emails
- Extract verify URLs and complete signup flow

Cleanup test users with:
- npx convex run oneTimeMigration:deleteTestUserByEmail '{"email": "<temp-email>"}'
